C.basis: point-in-time join to derived.financial_score_daily on (trade_date, ts_code)

R.unfunded_definition: candidates ordered on the signal day whose signal date produced no buy fill (budget race or no tradable open)
R.basis: point-in-time join to derived.financial_score_daily on (trade_date, ts_code)
